fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: the property being written to an input integral-typed parameter is an enum type or a nullable enum type
fields.trigger: an input enum-backed-integral parameter expression is built for that property
fields.response: convert the enum value to its nullable underlying integral type before passing it to the provider's add-parameter method, substituting a null constant of that underlying type when a nullable enum property currently has no value
fields.postcondition: a non-enum integral property is passed to the add-parameter method unconverted
